game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood, the glowing ancient tree: the forest ranger must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Pattern Painter: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the spirit shrine.
theme: Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood: the glowing ancient tree
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowing Heartwood, repeat each round: Print growing star triangles with nested loops to decorate the spirit shrine. Each round, a new glowing seeds challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the pattern_rows value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 320 points of glowing seeds by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 320, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 10 (extended tier): Pattern Painter
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pattern Painter' (Week 5 slot 7), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Glowing Heartwood'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
